requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个多功能计数与显示系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于加一计数，D3 用于减一计数，数码管实时显示计数值；当计数达到上限 20 或下限 0 时蜂鸣器报警，并禁止继续越界。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Start at initial model values (io_0=false, io_1=false). Apply a single rising edge on io_0 (pressed then release) while io_1 remains false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: After the press-edge control step, io_3 increases by 1 from 0; io_2 remains 0 because counter is neither 0 nor 20.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个多功能计数与显示系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于加一计数，D3 用于减一计数，数码管实时显示计数值；当计数达到上限 20 或下限 0 时蜂鸣器报警，并禁止继续越界。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: With io_0=false, apply a single rising edge on io_1 (pressed then release) from the initial state where counter is 0.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: counter stays at 0; io_3 remains 0; io_2 is nonzero (alarm) because counter==0.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个多功能计数与显示系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于加一计数，D3 用于减一计数，数码管实时显示计数值；当计数达到上限 20 或下限 0 时蜂鸣器报警，并禁止继续越界。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply 20 successive rising edges on io_0 with io_1 kept false (between edges, release io_0 back to false).
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: On reaching counter==20, io_3 shows 20 and io_2 becomes nonzero (alarm).

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个多功能计数与显示系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于加一计数，D3 用于减一计数，数码管实时显示计数值；当计数达到上限 20 或下限 0 时蜂鸣器报警，并禁止继续越界。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: From counter==20 (achieved as in T3), apply one more rising edge on io_0 while keeping io_1 false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: counter remains 20 (no further increase); io_3 remains 20; io_2 remains nonzero (alarm) because counter==20.
